mechanism_narrative: A quarterly demand surge (GDPC1 > 16,500) triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 returns by compressing discount rates on equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns negative despite GDPC1 > 16500 in 3 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.9%) signals labor market weakening, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns positive despite UNRATE > 4.9 in 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly (GDPC1) and monthly (HOUST) demand growth above thresholds amplifies positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed thresholds in same month.

mechanism_narrative: Dual monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 0.4% and CPIAUCSL < 240) in late-cycle expansion drives positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns negative despite dual monetary easing in late-cycle context over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly labor employment (PAYEMS) below 140,000 triggers negative 5-day S&P 500 returns via reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns positive despite PAYEMS falling below 140,000 in 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained supply growth (INDPRO > 105) in a steady-state regime drives positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns negative despite sustained INDPRO growth over 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly (GDPC1) and monthly (RSAFS) demand surges above thresholds amplify positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative when both GDPC1 and RSAFS exceed thresholds in same month.

mechanism_narrative: High FEDFUNDS (above 4.5%) and rising CPIAUCSL (above 240) in a tightening cycle signal inflation concerns, driving negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns positive despite high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL in tightening regime over 18 months.
